label: Synthetic worked example — not customer evidence.

findings.title: Synthetic server identifier is exposed
findings.observed_condition: The fixture returned the deliberate Server header synthetic-fixture/1.0.
findings.impact: A real service identifier could aid fingerprinting; this fixture value is intentionally synthetic.
findings.remediation: Minimize unnecessary server-identifying headers where operationally practical.
findings.retest: Repeat the same header-only observation against T-01.

findings.title: Synthetic transport policy header is absent
findings.observed_condition: The approved response did not contain Strict-Transport-Security.
findings.impact: On a real HTTPS service this could reduce browser transport enforcement; the fixture intentionally uses HTTP.
findings.remediation: For a real HTTPS service, evaluate HSTS after confirming subdomain and preload implications.
findings.retest: Observe the same response headers only; do not reopen discovery.

findings.title: Synthetic public metadata marker is exposed
findings.observed_condition: The fixture returned the deliberate X-Synthetic-Exposure header.
findings.impact: This is a demonstration marker and has no customer impact.
findings.remediation: Remove demonstration-only public metadata in a real deployment.
findings.retest: Repeat the same header-only observation against T-02.
